objective: Do deterministic past-only motion features improve ACTUAL reward-only learned action selection on original source when matched with same-capacity raw and sham features and temporally miscredited reward controls? No expert action labels.
hypothesis: With source-held-out real CartPole resets, reward-only PPO using explicit causal past motion features will improve real return over raw and feature-sham with matched 49152 actual train decisions per arm per initialization, while requiring transfer to unseen source pole conditions.

train.update_style: original P20: 96 rollouts x 8 actual envs x 64 source actions, PPO epochs 3, batch 256, original hyperparameters and true-action credit unchanged for positive models
train.actor_model: same GRU input10, hidden9, actor2, critic1 across all arms
train.motion_features: Four deterministic, only previous observations: x velocity from backward x difference/0.02, theta velocity from backward angle difference/0.02, x acceleration from second backward diff/0.02^2, theta acceleration from second backward diff/0.02^2; first row derivative zero and first two rows acceleration zero, no padded cross-episode differencing
train.input_scale: original P19 source raw six-channel scale [.5,.5,10,5,1,1] with true velocities masked, plus four separately fixed analytic scales [.5,1.0,.05,.05] applied to derived physical motion. Raw/control slots zero or placebo [-1,+1]. No fitted normalization, no separate data source.
train.placebo: For each historical decision, four stable SHA256 pseudorandom numbers based ONLY on previously executed action/reward sequence, episode-history length, model seed and P30 domain separator; NO cart/pole positions and NO true motion; placebo bytes cannot reproduce finite difference; deterministic repeat on same history.
train.credit_negative: Use exactly P20 corrupt_action_credit, but identical seed/weights and derived features; trajectories may diverge on-policy so no exact paired-gradient causal attribution.

frozen_decision.architecture_superiority_claim_requires: Derived PPO mean >= conventional full-observation teacher-free fixed two-frame baseline on all three physics conditions and seeds plus matched compute/resource qualification; otherwise no superiority
